note: Achievements (QST-009, F-UI-REWARD level 2): named moments in the player's life, each earned once and kept. An achievement is earned the first time a fact about the player reaches a number; the facts are worked out from the ledger, the quests and the property market (Tools/citysim/achievements.py), never counted up separately. job_memo is how a job's payment begins in the ledger (Tools/citysim/quests.py). Names, lines and numbers are [ASSUMPTION]: the owner may reword and retune them. banner_s is how long the banner stays; several earned together are shown one after another.
